dedupe_keys.name: four cogeneration plants python resilience analysis model

description: The public Mendeley version 2 deposit supplies a Python script, a README, system-information workbooks and example resilience-metric calculations for four cogeneration or power plants. The Data in Brief authors present it as a reusable calculation procedure in which a new user describes a system and supplies its simulated operation. The repository file list verifies a script named resilience analysis.py and nine companion text or spreadsheet files, under CC BY 4.0. Its purpose is to calculate a resilience response from plant time series, not to distribute a general power-grid simulator. The published example covers four plants in the linked study and is limited by those system assumptions and partial input data. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing disruption and recovery metrics across alternative plant configurations after creating compatible input workbooks. model-pypsa is a related electricity planning model, but no direct exchange format or validated joint workflow is established. The code and spreadsheets were not downloaded or executed.
name: Four cogeneration plants Python resilience-analysis model
notes: G2-0608. Metadata only. Proposed simulation uses are reviewer assessments. No dataset, model or article PDF downloaded; no program executed.
